column1: # MUST_CONTAIN.tsv -- the BOM for v1.0.97.
# THIS FILE IS THE SOURCE. CM051 VENDORS IT.
# CM051 scripts/sync_cut_bom.sh copies this file into cuts/v1.0.97/ there and
# records the OS003 commit it came from in cuts/BOM_PIN.
# WHY THIS CUT EXISTS
# v1.0.94 was TAGGED ONCE AT 62db9cc8583c7e47e7f0ea1254ea6cb502288a45 AND
# NEVER BUILT. check-manifest and check-pr-age were both fully clean this
# time (20 PASS 0 FAIL 0 CANNOT-RUN; PR-age PARTIAL (DECLARED) naming six
# repos). The new blocker was check-freshness: wiki:wiki-compiler and
# wiki:wiki-site both STALE:+12 against CM044 main, because the pinned
# images predated twelve merged commits including CM044 #275 (kill decimal-
# hour ages, add per-source status icons, remove a duplicate mkdocs nav
# entry, finish the People/timeline + People/index dated-list treatment) --
# the fix Andy asked for repeatedly. Rebuilt and re-pinned rather than
# acknowledged: a hold_ack would have asserted shipping_bugfixes_grafted =
# true while shipping none of the twelve.
# v1.0.97 carries v1.0.91/v1.0.92/v1.0.93/v1.0.94's daemon payload UNCHANGED
# (hub-v0.4.80) PLUS the wiki image re-pin: CM051 PR #1948, both images
# rebuilt by CM044 CI (release-images.yml, tag v0.1.32 = 67fe4054) and
# re-pinned by digest in install.sh, verified BY CONTENT (docker create +
# docker cp, sha256 against git blobs) rather than taken from either job's
# claim.
what

THE FRONT PAGE SIGNAL FETCH AUTHENTICATES, restoring the Needs you now band. The vendored cm059 signals.py reads the loopback service token; without it the fetch 401d and the band was empty on every install.
EVERY LOOPBACK CLIENT OF A GATED SERVICE MUST AUTHENTICATE, as a wired gate rather than a convention.
A SLOT HOLDER BURNING NO CPU IS HUNG, NOT BUSY, and is now stopped instead of blocking the queue for the dispatch ceiling.
THE DOCTOR SERVES THE EDITOR-FEEDBACK ROUTE and renders the per-source ingest table.
THE FRONT PAGE TAP REACHES THE STORE ON THE ARTEFACT. cm059_editor re-pinned to 1f5bfb3a: the card controls POST to api/v1/editor/feedback and carry data-card-id, where the vendored copy had neither.

THE RECOVERY KEY CAN BE REDEEMED AND THE DB KEY REACHES THE DATABASES. ostler-unlock added; existing databases migrated rather than left plaintext; ostler-recovery refuses on a passphrase-primary box and names ostler-unlock instead of misdirecting to Time Machine.

THE DOCTOR CREDENTIAL ROUTES STOP ANSWERING ANOTHER SITE. Closes the drive-by browser path only: a non-browser or tailnet caller sending no Origin is NOT held, by design, because the iOS client sends only Accept.
